summary: Discussion snapshot: surge of social reports about agent sandboxes, security/communication risks, vendor releases (DeepSeek, OpenAgent), and multiple operator incident reports; threads surface infra projects (Runtime, Magnitude) and guardrails (OpenAPPA). | Vendor updates: Cloudflare and AWS publish agent controls and evals; Cursor flags malicious VS Code extension; GHSA discloses mem0 cross-tenant leak; E2B and U Mobile case studies show operator workflows. | GitHub-sourced vendor releases (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Vercel, Cloudflare) dominate signal; several high-star infra primitives for agent memory, security, and routing appear but lack independent corroboration. Missing social/operator reports for user-workflow signals. | Packages snapshot: mix of major-vendor agent runtimes/extensions (OpenAI, OCI, Amazon), many MCP/memory/sandbox primitives and VS Code agent extensions; no social/user-field reports in this shard.
